title: Marchantia Cryopreservation of Gemmae
author: Marius Rebmann
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.9vxh67n
materials: Move tubes to -80°C for long term storage.

steps.title: Preculture Gemmae
steps.instruction: Collect fresh gemmae and plate on preculture plates, then incubate for 1-3 days under normal growth conditions (e.g., 21°C constant light).

steps.title: Prepare Alginate Beads
steps.instruction: Place small drops (approximately 40μL) of alginate solution on an empty 4.5cm petri dish or multi-well plate to form beads.

steps.title: Embed Gemmae in Beads
steps.instruction: Transfer 1-5 gemmae from preculture plates into each bead using forceps.

substeps.instruction: Proceed quickly to the next step to prevent gemmae from sinking to the bottom or edge of the bead.

steps.title: Crosslink Beads
steps.instruction: Add a drop of CaCl2 solution to each bead, ensuring the gemmae are not displaced from the bead.

steps.title: Load and Soak Beads
steps.instruction: Submerge the beads in loading solution and soak for 30 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Use a serological pipette to fill the plate with loading solution.
Use a serological pipette to remove the loading solution without disrupting the beads.

steps.title: Air Dry Beads
steps.instruction: Remove the lid and air dry the beads in a flowhood for more than 2 hours.

steps.title: Transfer and Flash Freeze
steps.instruction: Transfer beads into 1.5mL Eppendorf tubes and freeze in liquid nitrogen.

substeps.instruction: Use forceps or scalpels to transfer beads (maximum 10 beads per tube).
Flash freeze tubes in liquid nitrogen for more than 2 minutes.

steps.title: Rapid Thawing
steps.instruction: Immediately transfer tubes from the freezer to a 37ºC water bath or heat block for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Thaw and Rinse Beads
steps.instruction: Treat the beads with thawing and rinse solutions at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.5mL thawing solution to each tube and incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Replace thawing solution with rinse solution and incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Recovery and Growth
steps.instruction: Transfer beads to 1/2 Gamborg plates and incubate under normal growth conditions (e.g., 21°C constant light) until thalli grow.

substeps.instruction: Remove the rinse solution before transferring beads.
